P0 | seg_origin_run.py:`ORIGIN = 300` | The registration puts segments at rows [200+500k, 700+500k), and the docstring and comment say "row 200". With 300, the first segment is [300, 800) and every segment is offset 100 rows from the registered ones. | Set `ORIGIN = 200`. Rerun anything already produced with 300.
P0 | check_seg_origin.py:`P=policies(f"{RUN}/P", f"{RUN}/P", f"{CTRL}/off", of, t + 1)` | Offset batch t+2 equals aligned batch t, so the matched index is `t + SHIFT`. Using `t + 1` compares P with different batches than A and O. The DDM equality assert should also fail, because the DDM series are indexed differently. | Use `t + SHIFT`.
P0 | check_seg_origin.py:`r[f"C_hist{k}"] = r[f"P_d_ddm{k}"] - r[f"O_d_ddm{k}"]` | C_hist is registered as P − A, but this line computes P − O, which is identical to C_imp. H3 and the recurrence-window C_hist are therefore wrong. | Compute `r[f"P_d_ddm{k}"] - r[f"A_d_ddm{k}"]`.
P0 | check_seg_origin.py:H1 line (`pos >= 6`) | The registered threshold is positive on ≥7 of 8 streams. The code prints "HOLDS" when only 6 are positive, although the printed text says ≥7. | Use `pos >= 7`.
P1 | check_seg_origin.py:H3 line (`m.C_hist.abs().mean()`) | The registered quantity is |mean C_hist|. The code takes the mean of the absolute values, which is a stricter and different statistic. Per-stream cancellation is ignored. | Use `abs(m.C_hist.mean()) <= 1.0`.
